findings.summary: Accordion headings and Expand All / Collapse All cannot be activated by keyboard.
findings.fix: Render native buttons inside headings and native Expand All / Collapse All buttons; retain click handling and expose aria-expanded on each disclosure.
findings.evidence: Production /start/: focused heading Enter and Space leave li class unchanged; click changes class to active. Expand/Collapse All spans have tabIndex=-1. Source lines18-45. See evidence/behavior.json.

findings.summary: Copy code controls are click-only spans excluded from keyboard navigation.
findings.fix: Create button type=button with an accessible Copy code name and preserve the clipboard handler so Enter and Space work.
findings.evidence: document.createElement("span") creates .btn-clipboard; only a click handler is registered at line 130.

findings.summary: Message dismissal icons cannot be reached or activated by keyboard.
findings.fix: Replace the close icon with button type=button named Dismiss message; hide its decorative icon and preserve click handling.
findings.evidence: ; djangoproject.js:16-23 attaches only click.

findings.summary: The global slash shortcut cannot be disabled, remapped, or restricted to a focused component.
findings.fix: Keep Ctrl/Command+K, and either remove the unmodified slash shortcut or provide a persistent disable/remap preference; ignore editable content.
findings.evidence: Production homepage: pressing / while logo is focused moves focus to #id_q. Source window handler supports unmodified / without disable/remap preference.

passed: Base template contains a skip link to main-content.
Main navigation menu toggle uses a native button.
No positive tabindex values found in reviewed templates.
notes: Runtime keyboard testing and focus contrast measurements are handled by the parent audit.
